messages:
tariq: quick follow-up from the GPU postmortem \u2014 we need a compact remediation plan that covers quota, autoscaler/scheduler tuning, and an operational headroom playbook. aiming for owners + short measurable deliveries. i'll host a 25-min weekly sync.

maya: i'll take scheduler/autoscaler tuning. propose two waves: conservative emergency defaults (apply in 3-5d) and optimized tuning (2-3 iter cycles over 2w). will provide a config diff for emergency defaults.

anita: i'll own quota uplift and procurement. opening vendor/cloud tickets today, looping finance for temporary spend approvals. will add ETA for responses into the tracker.

sam: i'll draft the headroom/playbook doc. it should include: immediate mitigations (route disable, rate limits), temporary burst pool ops, and a validation checklist for canary traffic. first draft by +6d.

opsbot: created REM-5017 and calendar event "GPU Remediation Pulse" (Thurs 11:00 PT). subtasks assigned.

metrics-bot: incident snapshot: peak GPU util 99%, sustained p99 queueing. current free headroom ~5%-7% depending on cluster. stored metrics at s3://incidents/gpu/2098765432/snapshot.json

```
Action summary (confirm owners/dates):
- QUOTA UPLIFT: owner=anita, due=+3d, steps=[open tickets, estimate lead time, temporary spend approval]
- SCHEDULER/AUTOSCALER EMERGENCY CONFIG: owner=maya, due=+5d, steps=[apply conservative defaults, smoke test, revert plan]
- SCHEDULER OPTIMIZATIONS: owner=maya, due=+21d, steps=[perf runs, tuned yaml, validate under synthetic load]
- HEADROOM PLAYBOOK: owner=sam, due=+6d, steps=[draft, tabletop, automation hooks]
- DASHBOARDS & ALERTS: owner=tariq, due=+2d, steps=[headroom gauges, surge thresholds, paging rules]
```

tariq: i'll create the tracker and add these action rows. if anyone needs ephemeral GPUs for validation say so; i'll allocate up to 6 for tests.

maya: requesting 4 ephemeral GPUs next week for perf runs. will post exact windows in tracker.

anita: opening vendor/cloud tickets now, will paste links. finance pinged for approvals.

sam: runbook will include an escalation ladder and short runbook script snippets (disable-route, reserve-burst). will also add a quick play for canary rollback.

opsbot: REM-5017 updated with subtasks and owners. reminder set 24h before sync.

metrics-bot: 72h headroom projection: ~6% free GPUs; recommend pre-warming burst pool before high-traffic days.

tariq: thanks team. first sync this Thurs to review baselines and ticket responses. update tracker with any blockers beforehand.
